title: Oil Rubbed Bronze Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf - 8.75-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Toilet Paper Holder - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep bathroom essentials organized and off the counter with a toilet paper holder that adds a convenient glass shelf above the roll — available in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this Waverly Place design pairs clean, finished installation with enduring solid brass construction.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Coordinates with other Waverly Place pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Built for daily use: solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives
  • Easy to coordinate: part of the Waverly Place collection (matching Waverly Place) for a unified bath

Specs

  • Product type: Two post toilet tissue holder with glass shelf
  • Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
  • Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 8.75 in x 4.6 in x 6 in
  • Projection: 6 in
  • Weight capacity: 250 lb
  • Product weight: 5.6 lb
  • Included: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Waverly Place collection.
meta_description: Wall-mount toilet paper holder with glass shelf, solid brass construction, 8.75 in length. Concealed mounting and limited lifetime warranty. Waverly Place.
